summary: Iter 333 web verification for the 8-point batch (identity-guard client rendering, provider-email fields, price-checker sanity-guard redesign, plus regression touchpoints). VERIFIED end-to-end on web: (a) Provider Price Checker quality-guard redesign — data-testid='pc-quality-guard' renders with the terracotta/clay 2px border card + Alert/Quick sanity check icon; data-testid='pc-guard-continue' is a solid teal button (computed backgroundColor rgb(14, 77, 82) = colors.primary) and CLICK REVEALS the full price comparison result (You pay $250/hour vs typical $85–$115 range). Tested against extreme rate $250/hr Personal care by cathy on Dorothy. (b) All source-level testIDs required by the review are present in the code paths (grep-verified): decoder-identity-warning (StatementDecoderTool.jsx:388, tool/[slug].tsx:264), inv1-identity-warning (InvoiceCheckerTool.jsx:620, InvoiceResultView.tsx:20), form-provider-email + edit-provider-email (Participants.jsx:769,904 + mobile participants.tsx:483), lf1-edit-letter / lf1-generated-body-edit / lf1-open-in-email (mobile letters/[id].tsx:935,953,937), NotificationsContext.markRead does setItems(filter !== id) + POST /notifications/read and markAllRead does setItems([]) + POST /notifications/read {ids:[]} (context lines 76 & 89). NOT RUNTIME-EXERCISED in this pass (see action_items): decoder-identity-warning + inv1-identity-warning banners did not render at runtime because (i) my paste-text sample triggered the DEC-1 pre-decode UploadGuard 'We can't review this document' strict block (visible in screenshot iter333_decoder_mismatch.jpeg — a real PDF upload of a mismatched participant is required to reach the decode result and surface the advisory identity_warning); (ii) Invoice Checker UI is upload-only (no paste-text tab) so the same real-PDF walkthrough is needed. Participants Add-form open did not surface data-testid='form-provider-email' or 'edit-provider-email' in my automation click — source shows the fields are wired, so this is likely a modal-selector miss in my script rather than a code regression; main-agent should self-verify with a real click. Mobile Expo preview was NOT exercised at runtime this iteration due to token budget; all mobile testIDs are source-grep verified.

critical_code_review_comments: Price Checker QualityGuardPanel redesign lands the requested standout treatment: terracotta 2px border + Alert icon badge + solid teal Continue button (rgb 14,77,82) — visually distinct and high-contrast in light. Dark-theme legibility not verified in this run.
NotificationsContext markRead/markAllRead correctly perform optimistic mutation THEN network call with rollback on error (context lines 76-83, 88-96) — good pattern.

identity_guard._is_match is intentionally lenient (single-token → substring; multi-token → surname + shared token) and includes a _PLACEHOLDERS suppression for 'Mum'/'Dad' when there are no other real-named participants — avoids false positives when the primary is stored as a nickname. cathy's household has Dorothy Smith as primary (real name), so 'Robert Jones' would correctly fire the 'no_match' branch (or the 'other_participant' branch if Patricia Holloway had a matching token — not the case here).
Decoder result.identity_warning is only surfaced when a decode result exists — good gating (won't render on the strict UploadGuard block screen).

Non-blocking: Add-participant modal open selector 'button:has-text(Add Participant)' matched but subsequent form-provider-email locator returned 0. Suggests the field is behind a Provider section that may be collapsed by default OR requires scrolling; main agent should verify visibility on modal open.
